name: Somewhere to Belong
source:
Chris Ideni, a notable physician, is fleeing from Arazem, a nation at war with itself.

His old friend, Leroy Atemat, a mathematician and scientist, has come to help him reintegrate back into their home country, the Sethian Empire.

As wartime fades into the background, they both discover that there might be more to their relationship than they thought.

[From [url=https://arbiterbrave.itch.io/somewhere-to-belong]Itch.io[/url]]
